HOW TO PLAY

CONTROLS

Player 1 (blue)↑↓←→ · fire End / Space · handbrake R-Shift
Player 2 (red)WASD · fire F · handbrake L-Shift
Solo raceeither set works
Rocket startpress gas when the countdown says 2
Jumpspress handbrake in the air for a trick boost
NitroPgDn (P1) · G (P2) · fill it with drifts, jumps, near misses, takedowns & slipstreams
Drift boosthold handbrake + steer: blue, orange, then purple sparks!
Swap sidesTab in 2-player
MusicM on / off
Quit to menuEsc

Shield · blocks the next hit
Shrink · everyone else goes tiny & slow · squash them!
Seeker · drone that flies to the car in 1st
